title: QUAL: Quantile Alignment Improves Zero-Shot Time-Series Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.41100v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) provide zero-shot forecasts for unseen series, but their accuracy varies across datasets. Combining several models can reduce this variability, yet zero-shot deployment provides no target labels for selecting or weighting them. We find that a model pool is useful not only as a final ensemble, but also as a probability reference for transforming each member forecast. Aligning quantiles through this pool-relative reference improves every member forecast in aggregate. Motivated by this finding, we propose QUAL (Quantile alignment), a simple label-free framework for improving and combining diverse TSFMs. QUAL first produces aligned member forecasts, then applies Huber aggregation and rearrangement to obtain a robust combined forecast without training or model modification. translated_title: QUAL：分位数对齐提升零样本时间序列基础模型
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）能够对未见过的序列进行零样本预测，但其准确性在不同数据集之间存在差异。组合多个模型可以减少这种变异性，然而零样本部署中没有目标标签可用于选择或加权这些模型。我们发现，模型池不仅可以作为最终的集成，还可以作为转换每个成员预测的概率参考。通过这种池相对参考进行分位数对齐，可以在总体上改进每个成员的预测。基于这一发现，我们提出了QUAL（分位数对齐），一个简单的无标签框架，用于改进和组合多种TSFMs。QUAL首先生成对齐后的成员预测，然后应用Huber聚合和重排以获得稳健的组合预测，无需训练或修改模型。在GIFT-Eval上，分位数对齐使平均成员MASE和CRPS分别降低了7.4%和9.8%。当存在弱（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出QUAL无标签框架，将模型池作为概率参考进行分位数对齐，无需训练或修改模型即可改进并组合多种时间序列基础模型的零样本预测。
en_tdlr: QUAL proposes a label-free framework that uses a model pool as a probability reference for quantile alignment, improving and combining diverse time-series foundation models' zero-shot forecasts without training or model modification.
